quote: AutoTOD directly outputs the natural language responses rather than the delexicalized utterances
Traditional TOD systems ... include natural language generation. AutoTOD directly outputs the natural language responses rather than the delexicalized utterances.

AutoTOD can intelligently and autonomously decide to call an external API with proper parameters and summarize the API results into the final responses, which greatly flexes the rigid process of state tracking and database querying in traditional TOD models.
outputs: system response utterances in the dialogue

quote: Here we use some language diversity metrics to evaluate the quality of model responses . The metrics include some statistics about words, n-gram and information entropy (number of n-grams, Shannon Entropy (SE), Conditional bigram Entropy (CE), Mean Segmental Type-Token Ratio (MSTTR), Measure of Textual Lexical Diversity (MTLD) and Hypergeometric Distribution Function (HDD)) .
We also use some language diversity metrics ... The metrics include ... BLEU ... Inform, Success, Book, Combine ... SE, CE, MSTTR, MTLD, HDD.
The results show the superior task completion ability and fluent language skills of AutoTOD.
the dialogue evaluator employs a pretrained large language model, (GPT-3.5 in our experiments) to extract essential information from the generated dialogues.
The dialogue evaluator employs a pretrained large language model (GPT-3.5) to extract essential information from the generated dialogues.

We also propose a novel TOD evaluation approach to validate the system's ability to complete user goals where another instruction-following language model is used to extract the key information that the system provides to the user from the dialogues.

We conduct human evaluation to supplement the limitations of automated metrics. We sample 100 dialogues from the test set and ask for 5 graduate students to rate from 4 aspects: language fluency (Fluency), dialogue coherence (Coherence), information accuracy in responses (Informativeness), and overall satisfaction (Satisfaction).
